subject: chb01
notes: Multichannel CHB-MIT preictal-vs-interictal PREDICTION model (offline thesis artifact + optional backend engine). Expects an in_ch-channel montage window, per-channel z-scored and resampled to input_len at fs Hz; P(class 1)=P(preictal). safety_gap_min is the SPH (seizure prediction horizon); preictal_min is the labeling window before onset. IMPORTANT: in_ch/channels/input_len here MUST match the trained cnn_lstm_chbmit.pt -- reconcile them with train.py's printed 'in_ch=' and window_sec*fs before dropping the weights into backend/models/. Set decision_threshold from metrics_chbmit.json val_tuned_threshold (min_sens>=0.8). The live single-channel VitalWindow does NOT match in_ch, so predict_proba returns None on it and the transparent heuristic drives the live demo; this model is exercised on genuine multichannel windows offline.
